data.name: Bradly
data.long_meaning: The name Bradly is derived from Old English, specifically from the elements Brád and lēah. Brád means broad or wide, and lēah means meadow or clearing. Thus, the name Bradly can be interpreted as a dweller in a broad meadow or clearing.

in_hebrew.name: ברדלי
in_hebrew.meaning: ברדלי הוא שם שמקורו באנגלית ומשמעותו רחב, גלוי
in_hebrew.long_meaning: ברדלי הוא שם שמקורו באנגלית ומשמעותו רחב, גלוי. השם ברדלי נגזר מהמילים האנגליות 'broad' ו-'ley', שמשמעותן רחב ומרעה. השם ברדלי לא מופיע בתנ"ך העברי, אך הוא משמש כשם פרטי באנגלית ומוכר בעיקר כצורה מקוצרת של שמות ארוכים יותר.

in_greek.name: Μπράντλυ
in_greek.long_meaning: Μπράντλυ σημαίνει πλατύς, ανοιχτός. Το όνομα Μπράντλυ προέρχεται από τα αγγλικά και συγκεκριμένα από τις λέξεις 'broad' και 'ley', που σημαίνουν πλατύ και λιβάδι αντίστοιχα. Δεν υπάρχει άμεση αναφορά στο όνομα Μπράντλυ στην Καινή Διαθήκη, αλλά χρησιμοποιείται ως προσωπικό όνομα στην αγγλική γλώσσα.

in_latin.name: Bradly
in_latin.long_meaning: Bradly significat latus, apertus. Nomen Bradly originem habet in lingua Anglica, derivatum ex vocibus 'broad' et 'ley', quae significant latus et prata. Quamquam nomen Bradly non invenitur in scripturis Christianis primitivis, tamen in uso est como nomen proprium in lingua Anglica.

in_english.name: Bradly
in_english.long_meaning: Bradly is of English origin, derived from the Old English words 'broad' meaning wide or spacious and 'ley' meaning meadow or clearing. Although not directly mentioned in the Bible, the name Bradly conveys a sense of openness and breadth, symbolizing freedom and expansiveness. Historically, it has been used as a given name in Christian traditions, signifying a broad or wide meadow, potentially reflecting a spacious or open personality.

data.cultural_impact: The name Bradly gained popularity in the English-speaking world during the Middle Ages, particularly in England, Scotland, and Ireland. It was a common name among farmers, who lived on broad lands. Later, it became popular among colonial settlers in America, representing the promise of new beginnings and wide open spaces. Today, Bradly is a commonly used name in many English-speaking countries and is associated with strength, broadness, and a sense of comfort and stability.

However, in modern times, it has become more popular as a masculine name, particularly in the film and television industry, with notable figures such as Brad Pitt and Bradley Cooper bearing the name.
